character: A halfling man in his forties, short and stocky, tidy brown curls, clean-shaven. A beaming wide smile. Frightened eyes. Eyebrows raised and pinched together
wardrobe: a fine wine-red brocade coat with gold-thread edging, a rose silk waistcoat, a cream cravat, immaculate and slightly too formal for him

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, hands clasped in front of him.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame.
